What makes us different?

  • 01
    Only 4 students per group class. You get real coaching on every drill. Nobody gets lost in a crowded line.
  • 02
    Built for true beginners. Safety first and zero intimidation, even if you have never held a firearm before.
  • 03
    Certified, safety-first instructors. Training led by NRA certified instructors who teach calm, clear fundamentals.
  • 04
    Private 1-on-1 if you prefer it. Learn at your own pace, ask anything, with no audience.
  • 05
    Florida concealed license covered. Beginner training that also covers Florida concealed weapons license (CWL) requirements.
  • 06
    Local to Miami and South Florida. Small classes, personal attention, and a welcoming place to start.
